buildCommand:
# NVIDIA publishes these DOCA OVS debs without source; the vendor stage
# verified each against NVKE's committed lock.
cd /src/os-image/packages/doca-ovs/nvkr-debs
packages=(*.deb)
test "${#packages[@]}" -eq 8
switch=(doca-openvswitch-switch_*_{{.Arch}}.deb)
test "${#switch[@]}" -eq 1
test -f "${switch[0]}"
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "${switch[0]}" Package)" = doca-openvswitch-switch
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "${switch[0]}" Architecture)" = "{{.Arch}}"
mkdir -p /src/nvkr-output
# The composer accepts only .deb archive members.
tar --format=ustar --sort=name --mtime="@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" \
  --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner \
  -cf /src/nvkr-output/nvke-doca-ovs.tar -- *.deb
vendorCommand:
test ! -e os-image/packages/doca-ovs/nvkr-debs
test ! -L os-image/packages/doca-ovs/nvkr-debs
# The source Makefile owns the DOCA version, package set and committed
# per-deb SHA-256 lock. Stage beside the checkout; protected vendors
# mount /tmp with noexec.
bundle_root="$(mktemp -d "$(dirname "$PWD")/nvkr-doca.XXXXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$bundle_root"' EXIT
timeout --kill-after=10s 540s make -C os-image/packages/doca-ovs debs \
  ARCH={{.Arch}} UBUNTU_SERIES=24.04 \
  DIST_DIR="$bundle_root/dist" OUT_DIR="$bundle_root/debs"
mkdir os-image/packages/doca-ovs/nvkr-debs
cp "$bundle_root/debs/"*.deb os-image/packages/doca-ovs/nvkr-debs/

buildCommand:
GOWORK=off GOFLAGS=-mod=vendor make -C agent deb-{{.Arch}} \
  VERSION="${BUILD_VERSION:?}" \
  NFPM_BIN=/usr/local/bin/nfpm \
  DEB_OUTPUT=/src/agent/bin/nvke-agent.deb
test -f "/src/agent/bin/nvke-agent.deb"
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "/src/agent/bin/nvke-agent.deb" Package)" = "nvke-agent"
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "/src/agent/bin/nvke-agent.deb" Architecture)" = "{{.Arch}}"

# Keep DHCP identity stable when NVKE moves L3 to its OVS bridge.
# Stage authored VM configuration; never modify the pinned source tree.
readonly files=/src/nvkr-output/native-image-files
mkdir -p "$files"
cp -a /src/os-image/files/. "$files/"
cat >"$files/00-dhcp-all.yaml" <<'NETPLAN'
network:
  version: 2
  renderer: networkd
  ethernets:
    all-en:
      match:
        name: "e*"
      dhcp4: true
      dhcp6: true
      dhcp-identifier: mac
      optional: true
NETPLAN
python3 /src/os-image/packer/scripts/compose-image-inputs.py \
  --architecture {{.Arch}} \
  --materials-dir /nvkr/inputs/materials \
  --source-files-dir "$files" \
  --output /src/nvkr-output/image-inputs.tar \
  --source-date-epoch "$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"

buildCommand:
# Keep DHCP identity stable when NVKE moves L3 to its OVS bridge.
# Stage authored VM configuration; never modify the pinned source tree.
readonly files=/src/nvkr-output/native-image-files
mkdir -p "$files"
cp -a /src/os-image/files/. "$files/"
cat >"$files/00-dhcp-all.yaml" <<'NETPLAN'
network:
  version: 2
  renderer: networkd
  ethernets:
    all-en:
      match:
        name: "e*"
      dhcp4: true
      dhcp6: true
      dhcp-identifier: mac
      optional: true
NETPLAN
readonly out=/src/nvkr-output
readonly materials="$out/materials"
mkdir -p "$materials"
# The composer refuses symlinks. Copy into this private writable view while
# preserving every original read-only material unchanged.
for binding in agent calico kubeadm-distro ovn spire-agent; do
  cp --reflink=auto "/nvkr/inputs/materials/$binding" "$materials/$binding"
done
# The composer accepts only .deb archive members, not the Make-generated index.
(cd /src/os-image/packages/doca-ovs/nvkr-debs && \
  tar --format=ustar --sort=name --mtime="@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" \
    --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner \
    -cf "$materials/doca-ovs" -- *.deb)
exec python3 /src/os-image/packer/scripts/compose-image-inputs.py \
  --architecture {{.Arch}} \
  --materials-dir "$materials" \
  --source-files-dir "$files" \
  --output "$out/image-inputs.tar" \
  --source-date-epoch "$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"

test ! -e os-image/packages/doca-ovs/nvkr-debs

trap 'rm -rf -- "$bundle_root"' EXIT

buildCommand:
set -o pipefail
export LC_ALL=C
printf '%s\n' "${NKECTL_COMMIT:?}" > bin/SOURCE_COMMIT
unset CAPI_VERSION
make --no-print-directory -s -f make/tool-versions.mk \
  --eval='nvkr-capi-version: ; @printf "%s\n" "$(CAPI_VERSION)"' \
  nvkr-capi-version > bin/CAPI_VERSION
# NVKE releases before the in-tree NKTP chart's removal install it
# from this path; later ones install the published chart instead.
nktp_chart=
if [ -d nktp/deploy/charts/nktp ]; then nktp_chart=nktp/deploy/charts/nktp; fi
# Keep sibling charts together for source-owned file:// dependencies.
charts=(controller/deploy/charts/*/)
tar --sort=name --format=ustar --mtime="@${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH:?}" \
  --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner --mode=u=rwX,go=rX \
  -cf - make/tool-versions.mk deploy/nvke-deploy.sh deploy/lib deploy/nico \
  cli/internal/bootstrap/sitespec/template.yaml \
  "${charts[@]%/}" ${nktp_chart} \
  controller/hack/apply-capi-spiffe-exec-auth.sh \
  controller/deploy/k8s/capi-spiffe-exec-auth \
  controller/test/fixtures/releases \
  controller/nico-sim/internal/seed/default-seed.yaml controller/nico-sim/ui \
  -C bin SOURCE_COMMIT CAPI_VERSION | gzip -n > bin/nvke-installer-sources.tar.gz

export GOENV=off GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local
target_os="${GOOS:?}"
target_arch="${GOARCH:?}"
env -u GOOS -u GOARCH make -C cli build-cross DIST=bin NVKECTL_PLATFORMS="$target_os/$target_arch" \
  LEGACY_BINARY_NAME= NVKECTL_VERSION="git-${NKECTL_COMMIT}" NVKECTL_COMMIT="${NKECTL_COMMIT}" \
  NVKECTL_DATE="${NKECTL_DATE}" NVKECTL_TREE=clean
cp "cli/bin/nvkectl-$target_os-$target_arch" cli/bin/nvkectl
vendorCommand:
cd cli
export GOENV=off GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=
pins="$(sha256sum go.mod go.sum ../controller/api/go.mod ../controller/api/go.sum ../controller/deploy/charts/go.mod ../management-engine/go.mod ../management-engine/go.sum)"
timeout --kill-after=10s 540s go mod download
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum --quiet -c -
GOPROXY=off timeout --kill-after=10s 60s go mod verify
GOPROXY=off timeout --kill-after=10s 180s go mod vendor
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum --quiet -c -

buildCommand: buildctl-daemonless.sh build --frontend dockerfile.v0 --local context=/src/. --local dockerfile=/src/controller --opt platform=linux/{{.Arch}} --opt build-arg:GOLANG_IMAGE=docker.io/library/golang@sha256:08bcb99a38f85a265f9a93d1d3323e2440eec333380f3ea26ee0dec9264bb41c --opt "build-arg:BUILD_VERSION=$BUILD_VERSION" --opt "build-arg:GIT_VERSION=$GIT_VERSION" --opt "build-arg:SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" --output type=oci,dest=/src/bin/nvke-controller-image-{{.Arch}}.oci.tar,oci-mediatypes=true

export GOENV=off GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=-mod=vendor
make -C cli build NVKECTL_TREE=clean
vendorCommand:
export GOENV=off GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=
# The source-owned charts module has no dependencies or go.sum.
test ! -e controller/deploy/charts/go.sum
pins="$(sha256sum cli/go.mod cli/go.sum controller/api/go.mod controller/api/go.sum controller/deploy/charts/go.mod management-engine/go.mod management-engine/go.sum)"
cd cli
timeout --kill-after=10s 540s go mod download
GOPROXY=off timeout --kill-after=10s 60s go mod verify
GOPROXY=off timeout --kill-after=10s 180s go mod vendor
cd ..
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum --quiet -c -
test ! -e controller/deploy/charts/go.sum
